list.title: Online petitions
list.summary: Since the counter closed Friday at 4 pm, {total} came in online. {withQuestions}

summaryWithQuestions.zero: None have questions the counter would ask.
summaryWithQuestions.one: 1 has questions the counter would ask.
summaryWithQuestions.other: {n} have questions the counter would ask.

list.scopeNote: Desk checks stalking and harassment petitions. Domestic violence petitions go straight to review until those rules are written.

noPhoneNote.one: The question goes to review with the petition.
noPhoneNote.other: The questions go to review with the petition.

notes: Desk runs the same checks as ReadyFile on every online stalking and harassment petition. Each question traces to one rule and its source.
Nothing waits unless staff hold it. A hold lasts up to {hours} hours. Then the petition goes to the magistrate, answered or not.

hold.notHeldBody: It's in the magistrate's review queue now. Holding it gives the petitioner up to {hours} hours to answer.
hold.noPhone: No phone number, so there's no one to follow up with.
hold.heldBody: You held it at {time} {weekday}. It goes to the magistrate then, answered or not.
hold.heldByMagistrateBody: It was held at {time} {weekday}. It goes to the magistrate then, answered or not.
hold.magistrateAsked: The magistrate asked for follow-up at {time}.
hold.sentBody: Sent at {time}. The hold has ended.

timeline.holdPreview: If you hold it now: until {time}

alternative.heading: Timeline, as text
alternative.holdPreview: Hold: not held. If you hold it now, it lasts until {time}.

sentence.noOverlapTexts: The call times given don't overlap the counter's hours. A text link lets the petitioner add details before the hold ends.
sentence.noOverlapNoTexts: The call times given don't overlap the counter's hours, and the petitioner asked not to get texts.
sentence.overlap: The call times given overlap the counter's hours from {start} to {end}.

title.zero: No questions the counter would ask

questions.none: Desk found nothing the counter would ask about.

keepToInfo.title: Keep it to information
keepToInfo.information: Stalking is defined as two or more incidents. Are there other times you want to describe?

filedPetition.title: Petition as filed
filedPetition.narrativeLabel: Narrative from the {version} petition, with line numbers
filedPetition.splitNote: Incidents are split by paragraph and date phrases, the same way ReadyFile splits them.

contactPanel.title: Contact
contactPanel.message: Hi, this is Allen County staff about the form you sent on {filedDay}. You can add more details here until {endDay} {endTime}: [link]. Reply STOP to end texts.
contactPanel.messageNote: Neutral wording. It never names the case type or the other person.
contactPanel.holdFirst: Hold the petition to follow up.
contactPanel.linkTexted: Link texted at {time}. Not opened yet.
contactPanel.noTexts: The petitioner asked not to get texts.
contactPanel.outsideCallTimes: It's outside the call times given.

activity.title: Activity

checked.zero: Desk checked the petition and found no questions.
checked.one: Desk checked the petition and found 1 question.
checked.other: Desk checked the petition and found {n} questions.

checkedAmended.zero: Desk checked the amended petition and found no questions.
checkedAmended.one: Desk checked the amended petition and found 1 question.
checkedAmended.other: Desk checked the amended petition and found {n} questions.

activity.sentNow: Sent to the magistrate before the hold ended.
activity.holdEnded: The hold ended, and the petition went to the magistrate.

amended.zero: The petitioner filed an amended petition.
amended.one: The petitioner filed an amended petition that adds 1 incident.
amended.other: The petitioner filed an amended petition that adds {n} incidents.

activity.askedFollowUp: The magistrate asked for follow-up. Held until {time}.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.note: Development only. These stand in for things that happen outside Desk. They don't appear in the real tool.
demo.addIncidents: The petitioner adds incidents through the link
demo.addIncidentsHint: Works on the sample petition that has an amendment, during a hold, after the link is texted.
demo.jump: Jump to the end of the hold

review.title: Ex parte review
review.intro: Petitions waiting for your review, oldest first.
review.caption: {petitioner} v. {respondent}
review.empty: No petitions are waiting for your review.

bench.title: {petitioner} v. {respondent}
bench.subtitle: {caseType} petition. Filed online {filed}{amended}. {queue}
bench.builtFrom: Built from the {version} petition. The petitioner's words are unchanged and sorted by date. Desk doesn't judge whether the petition meets any legal standard.
bench.recordNote: Staff can't edit petition text in Desk. Every word above is the petitioner's.

outcome.title: Record the outcome
outcome.intro: Enter your order as usual. Recording the outcome here shows the court why online petitions are denied.

caseTypeNotes.harassment: Granted ex parte isn't offered for harassment. The PO-0102 booklet says harassment-only petitions need notice and a hearing before any relief (team source K2).

outcome.reasonsSource: From the common denial reasons in the {source}.
outcome.toldTitle: What the petitioner will be told

told.none: Pick an outcome to see what the petitioner will be told.
told.granted-ex-parte: If the petitioner signed up for notices, the court's usual notices go out when the order is granted and served.
told.hearing: The petitioner gets the hearing date and time.
told.denied: The petitioner gets a new denial notice: your reason in plain words and the options available, in wording the court approves. No such notice exists today.

outcome.needReason: Pick at least one reason, or Other.
outcome.saved: Saved as {outcome}. Your order is still entered as usual.

openQuestions.ask: Ask the specialist to follow up
openQuestions.sent: Sent to {specialist}. It comes back to you within {hours} hours.
openQuestions.noPhone: No phone number, so there's no one to follow up with.

advice: This will be denied as it is.
adviceExamples.test: The test: if it says "you should," it's advice.
